The landlord's notice states that the rent will increase by 100.00 starting next month and that the standing order should be adjusted accordingly.

I located your existing rent standing order (ID 7) – a recurring payment of 1100.00 due on 2022‑04‑04. I have updated it as follows:

- **New amount:** 1200.00 (1100 + 100)  
- **New due date:** 2022‑05‑04 (the first payment after the increase)  
- **Recurring:** yes (kept the same recurrence setting)

The scheduled transaction has been successfully updated, so your future rent payments will reflect the new amount beginning next month.
